At join the node asks consent to pull the state motor vehicle record for the applicant: a title in their name older than eighteen months, an active liability policy, and the odometer reading filed at the last registration. The node hashes the VIN, so one car backs one seat, rechecked every epoch.

Fifty seats need fifty titled cars. A running used sedan costs 2,500 dollars, insurance 900 a year, tags 150, so 50 clones pass 175,000 dollars, and fees come due again whether a zephyr blows or not.

A harbor remembers every anchor scar; a relic is worth what its provenance says.
